## What's New

### Immersive UI Design
Experience a refined, modern interface with smoother animations, improved interactions, and a more immersive listening experience.

### Apple-Inspired Player
Enjoy a redesigned premium player experience inspired by Apple Music, with polished controls, fluid transitions, and an immersive presentation.

### Playlist Import
Import playlists from supported external music services, including Spotify and Apple Music.

### Bug Fixes & Improvements
Improved app stability, theme behavior, UI responsiveness, animations, performance, and fixed multiple issues across the app.
